question.prompt:
In right triangle \(ABC\), \(\angle C=90^\circ\), \(\angle A=30^\circ\), and \(AB=10\). What is \(BC\)? (Enter a numerical value.)

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_140_q1_question_en.svg)

solutions.explanation: The leg opposite a \(30^\circ\) angle equals half the hypotenuse, so \(BC=AB\div2=5\).
solutions.title: Use the 30° right-triangle property
